LastHorizon

A quiet afternoon on a coastal road. There is nowhere you need to be — walk up the hill, look around, and see what people left behind.

Objective

Five keepsakes are hidden around the neighbourhood. Walk close to one to pick it up. Your progress is saved in this browser.

Credits

Design, code, models, animation, shaders and audio created from scratch for this project. Every model in public/assets/models is generated by the Python scripts in scripts/blender; the soundtrack and effects are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API. No third-party assets are used.

Three.js · three-mesh-bvh · Vite · TypeScript · Blender
